digest.component_or_area: agent tooling harness, Bash tool hook system
propositions: A PreToolUse hook on the Bash tool must emit a brief reminder when the command invokes grep family tools (grep, rg, egrep, fgrep), surfacing Serena's symbol tools as the preferred alternative
The hook trigger must use plain string matching against grep-family tool names with no pattern classification or path heuristics, and must be deliberately tolerant of false positives

The reminder message must be 2–3 lines, non-blocking, and explicitly name both the preferred LSP path (find_referencing_symbols) and the legitimate grep use cases (string-literal searches, line numbers)

The hook must emit JSON via hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext for visibility to the model, must not include permissionDecision to remain non-blocking and preserve security posture, and must never exit non-zero or deny the call

The hook script must be tracked and testable at scripts/hooks/serena_grep_reminder.py, and must survive merging into .claude/settings.json while preserving the existing env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH setting from story C
